scope: Labelled future research/staffing and per-unit service/sales labour comparisons only. New service quantities and commercial rate are unresolved. Actual cash, full programme budget and commercial validation remain open.

records.basis: UK published comparison reference. Role mapping, bookable day/fraction and job inclusions require a real scope/quote; VAT/fees unresolved.

records.basis: UK published comparison reference. Role mapping, bookable day/fraction and job inclusions require a real scope/quote; VAT/fees unresolved.

records.basis: UK published comparison reference. Role mapping, bookable day/fraction and job inclusions require a real scope/quote; VAT/fees unresolved.

records.label: Hours used to normalise a day rate
records.basis: Explicit editable divisor, not a publisher-stated working day or guaranteed minimum booking.

records.label: Usable contributors by effort case
records.basis: Within existing six-to-ten target. Not actual recruited contributors or a predictive interval.

records.label: Scope, reader and method update
records.basis: Adapt an existing usable research structure, confirm reader/decision scope and plan the evidence work. Reusing a framework does not make old findings current. No client approval or completed future edition assumed.

records.label: Desktop evidence collection and screening
records.basis: Focused new/update search, primary-source reading, extraction, contrary evidence and reference maintenance. Includes useful evidence work, not repeating every internal check/file from the present project; paid datasets excluded unless separately selected.

records.label: Guide and record preparation
records.basis: Refresh the stable 14-question core/routing, forms, participant information and structured note/coding records for this edition. Does not change the core or authorise data collection. New material method changes may need more effort.

records.label: Research recruitment setup and coordination
records.basis: Plan introduction handoff, calendar, reminders and status review using JGA-provided routes. Not a recruitment guarantee. Variable individual handling is WR05; unsuccessful chasing beyond this assumed effort requires reforecast.

records.label: Individual scheduling, permission administration and clearance routing
records.basis: Allow individual arrangements, eligibility record handling, permission choices and necessary review routing. Model completed usable contributors as a workload driver only; this is not a conversion-rate assumption. Extra unsuccessful attempts remain additional work if incurred.

records.label: Contribution collection and structured note
records.basis: Preparation, a short structured interview or equivalent written handling, prompt note completion and clarifying follow-up. Not a promised interview duration. No recording/transcription or identifiable-data AI service assumed.

records.label: Contribution coding and comparison preparation
records.basis: Code usable material, record missing/contrary input and prepare cross-case comparison. Do not add a second full coding charge merely because the same permitted account informs Table analysis; extra Table-specific work stays separate.

records.label: Cross-case synthesis and Decision Framework
records.basis: Integrate desktop and original input, test contradictions, construct the supported Decision Framework and chapter logic. Small purposive input is not representative benchmarking. This is synthesis effort, with prose drafting in WR09.

records.label: Full narrative, executive summary and commercial preview
records.basis: Draft the complete agreed report, concise summary and two-page preview using the working two-part/eight-chapter structure. No arbitrary report word/page ceiling; changed agreed length or evidence complexity requires reforecast. Research collection/synthesis are separate rows.

records.label: Substantive fact, source, quotation and rights check
records.basis: Check consequential statements, reference links, participant/publication limits, exact quotations and evidence-to-claim fit. Not legal advice or a new ownership veto. WR05 administration and this publication review are distinct tasks; do not repeat the same clearance effort.

records.label: Copyediting and proofreading
records.basis: Improve language, consistency, tables and references; proof the final narrative/layout. Editorial hours are a separate work package, not a second full research rewrite.

records.label: JGA design and editable report assets
records.basis: Design report PDF/Word, reusable original graphic assets and report chart-data files; incorporate summary and preview consistently. Uses reusable design system and evidence-supported graphics. Excludes a website, Table financial workbook and invented quantitative charts.

records.label: One consolidated editorial revision allowance
records.basis: Process one coordinated feedback set, revise within the agreed outline and propagate affected files. Included contractual remedy work is not a new billable service. Allowance is planning effort, not a cap on corrections or an automatic surcharge.

records.label: Final format/data QA and portable handover
records.basis: Check exports, links, reusable chart data, editable assets, evidence/method templates and handover index. Report supporting Excel data only; no duplicate charge for separate Table financial-model production.

records.label: Provider project coordination
records.basis: Manage actual dependencies, client checkpoints, issue tracking and final handover coordination. Own labour only. JGA-side decision/review time is retained resource cost, not the same person charged twice.

records.label: First-edition research pricing and use-option preparation
records.basis: Prepare evidence-supported report pricing/licensing options and appropriate commercial preview use. Count a common analysis once if it also informs Table feasibility. This row is not the full six-comparable Table assessment, sponsor sales or contract advice.

records.label: Reader scope, context and priorities
records.basis: Provide operating context, decide focus and resolve questions. Proposed retained time, no named person or date assigned.

records.label: Introductions, eligibility context and follow-through
records.basis: Identify suitable introductions, provide relevant role context and assist when contact stalls. Planning block, not an assumed conversion funnel or guaranteed number of recruitable contacts. More chasing can increase actual effort.

records.label: Subject-matter and factual review
records.basis: Review consequential payroll/employer interpretation and JGA supplied material. Retained expertise does not replace independent fact checking. Review time can overlap with other JGA tasks only if actual work is the same.

records.label: Consolidated feedback and decisions
records.basis: Coordinate Nick/Mark feedback and agreed within-scope decisions. Client time alongside provider WR13, not an extra provider invoice.

records.label: Publication approval and handover decisions
records.basis: Confirm final publication/rights choices and practical receipt of assets. No approval, acceptance or publication permission presumed by the hours.

records.label: JGA project sponsor hourly resource cost
records.basis: JGA-specific cost input not supplied. Existing salary allocation is not automatically extra cash. No external freelancer benchmark substituted.

records.label: JGA relationship/recruitment owner hourly resource cost
records.basis: JGA-specific cost input not supplied. Existing salary allocation is not automatically extra cash. No external freelancer benchmark substituted.

records.label: JGA subject-matter reviewer hourly resource cost
records.basis: JGA-specific cost input not supplied. Existing salary allocation is not automatically extra cash. No external freelancer benchmark substituted.

records.label: JGA review coordinator hourly resource cost
records.basis: JGA-specific cost input not supplied. Existing salary allocation is not automatically extra cash. No external freelancer benchmark substituted.

records.label: JGA publication owner hourly resource cost
records.basis: JGA-specific cost input not supplied. Existing salary allocation is not automatically extra cash. No external freelancer benchmark substituted.

records.label: Applicable commercial owner hourly resource value
records.basis: No actual JGA salary, employment on-cost, opportunity-cost basis or scoped supplier commercial rate supplied. Keep unknown; broad editorial/research rates do not establish this rate.

records.label: Reusable commercial pack and campaign readiness
records.basis: Do not recreate or reprice the complete report, its commercial preview, or initial report use-option analysis already in WR09/WR16. A second campaign reuses the asset and costs only real updating work.

records.label: Campaign administration, pipeline review and close
records.basis: No automatic monthly sales team, retainer, CRM purchase or annual campaign count. Distinguish common review from the same customer contact/proposal work.

records.label: Individually handled prospect contact attempt
records.basis: Excludes substantive meeting work in WS04 and preparation/negotiation already in WS05/WS06. Not a lead quota, permission to contact or inferred conversion funnel.

records.label: Substantive sales discussion and immediate record
records.basis: T03 exploratory research is excluded. A no-show records only genuinely incurred preparation/handling, not an invented completed meeting; any real extra effort is retained in the same task record.

records.label: Initial scoped proposal preparation
records.basis: One partner proposal is one attempt, not a separate licence proposal plus briefing proposal for the same combined offer. This is proposal preparation, not new research or current Table feasibility.

records.label: Additional material proposal or negotiation round
records.basis: If a complete fresh proposal is counted in WS05, do not also count that same writing in WS06. Record preparation, call and revision within one round once.

records.label: Won order / agreement and entitlement setup
records.basis: Count the agreement once even if it includes a licence and briefing. Negotiation incurred before a lost order belongs in WS05/WS06. A signature/order record is not receipt of cash or completed fulfilment.

records.label: Customer-specific reading path through existing research
records.basis: The full free research benefit remains intact. Generic summary/preview and existing reading-path assets are reused; do not re-charge WR09/WR16 or repeat the same path because a bundle has several labels. Fresh evidence collection is outside this task.

records.label: Scoped client/public-use asset preparation and context check
records.basis: Use the existing rights review and original design from WR10/WR12. Charge only the additional permitted adaptation/check; no default third-party chart/identity/quote rights, blanket sublicence or new evidence. Multiple genuinely different agreed packages can require repeated work.

records.label: Partner recognition and benefit-register setup
records.basis: If research is already commissioned/complete, do not describe it as a new commission. This task excludes the licence/briefing work counted in WS07–WS09/WS12–WS15. No contact access, seats, exclusivity, favourable conclusions or recurring reporting is presumed.

records.label: Explicit partner benefit fulfilment administration
records.basis: No default monthly report or newly compulsory partner service. Reuse invoice, delivery and briefing records; do not redo the underlying work. Multiple real checks can create legitimate additional hours within the same bundle; do not remove them merely because the bundle is counted once.

records.label: Full-research fulfilment delivery run
records.basis: A common batch is counted once; no second free-copy charge for the same send. An additional recipient-specific delivery action or separate run is incremental real work, not a second research-production cost. Effort depends on recipient/route complexity; override the hours when material.

records.label: Scoped briefing preparation and scheduling
records.basis: No new research, unlimited inquiry or promised turnaround. Reuse a prepared briefing and count only the necessary preparation delta for a repeat audience/session. Where WS08 reading-path work is reused, credit only that exact saved task and allocate common person-time once. If an unchanged reusable preparation package supports several sessions, assign it once rather than duplicating full preparation. One joint session serving several entitled customers/partners is one session, not one per attendee or bundle.

records.label: Live scoped briefing delivery
records.basis: Duration/headcount are planning choices, not promised session lengths or staffing. A second necessary presenter is real additional person-time; do not multiply the same full task hours by every role. A repeat session is a real repeat unit even if preparation is reused.

records.label: Bounded briefing follow-through
records.basis: No general analyst inquiry desk, compliance advice, bespoke consulting, new study or recurring support is assumed. If one shared follow-up is reused for multiple sessions, allocate the common work once; genuinely different follow-up remains incremental.

records.label: Service-case triage and routing
records.basis: WS18 contains resolution and closing work for this same case; do not include it here. Paid, bundled and free recipients can create cases. No new support entitlement or participant form is created; fresh research/advice is outside the scope.

records.label: Invoice, receipt and fulfilment-status administration
records.basis: Invoice, cash receipt and delivery remain different statuses. Do not count invoice value and receipt as two revenues. Costs already included in supplier/package/admin fees are reconciled once. No tax/recovery/payment-platform rule is presumed.

records.label: Service-case resolution, correction routing and close
records.basis: New source/content correction, narrative revision, QA and ordinary contractual remedy stay in WR10/WR13/WR14 or the appropriate production route; this row contains only incremental customer resolution/routing/redistribution and does not create an extra fee. If several cases share a correction notice/replacement send, prepare/send it once and allocate that common work once; do not also count the same send in WS12. A separately requested new study or advisory service is not included.

records.label: Actually initiated renewal or expiry administration
records.basis: No auto-renewal, subscription, annual update, future council tenure or new edition is assumed. New prospecting/proposal/research work belongs in the relevant task once; do not add a full second sales cycle here by default.

records.label: Optional short cycle follow-through note
records.basis: This T02 benefit idea is uncommitted. No promised answer to every practitioner question, monthly note, advice desk, new research or event production. Distribution uses WS12 once; the same note is not produced separately for each partner/free recipient.

records.label: Campaign fulfilment readiness and distribution-route setup
records.basis: WR14 already covers final report QA and portable JGA handover; do not repeat it. Reuse an existing tested release/route and count only the genuinely necessary readiness check/update. If multiple campaigns share an unchanged configuration, allocate its setup once and retain only actual incremental checks. No new website, platform purchase or access restriction is required.
